scenario: Fictional profile: low-impact activity, light knee/shoulder loading, floor access possible; no diagnosis or personal health record stored.
gaps: Only one aerobic movement; genuine same-purpose aerobic substitutions are unavailable.
Only calf raise and bridge are selectable strengthening candidates; no selectable upper-body strengthening or dedicated higher-load abdominal pattern.
Gentle activation and mobility supply most core variety. Repeating them does not make a balanced strengthening programme.
The proposed shoulder-constrained profile removes the overhead reach from suggestions. Existing joint/recovery caps may make longer or repeated sessions infeasible.
The two Pilates additions remain review records only, absent from the live catalogue and planner.

rows.name: Easy march
rows.purposeReview: Aerobic movement; no cardiovascular intensity claim from time alone.
rows.individualReview: Low-impact stepping still loads knees/hips/ankles; review comfortable pace and balance.
rows.movementOutline: Stand tall. Step gently in place.
instructions: Stand tall. Step gently in place.

rows.name: Shallow squat
rows.purposeReview: Potential leg strengthening, not a core substitute.
rows.individualReview: Keep the current suitability/art lock. Comfortable reported squatting does not establish reviewed range or dose.
rows.movementOutline: Feet apart. Sit back a little. Rise slowly.
instructions: Feet apart. Sit back a little. Rise slowly.

rows.name: Wall push
rows.individualReview: Keep the current lock; loads shoulders, elbows and wrists. Do not substitute it for a light shoulder movement.
rows.movementOutline: Hands on a wall. Bend elbows, then press away.
instructions: Hands on a wall. Bend elbows, then press away.

rows.name: Calf raise
rows.individualReview: Review ankle/heel tolerance, knee loading and support needs. No automatic load progression.
rows.movementOutline: Hold support if needed. Lift heels, lower slowly.
instructions: Hold support if needed. Lift heels, lower slowly.

rows.name: Gentle reach
rows.purposeReview: Shoulder mobility only; neither cardio nor strengthening.
rows.individualReview: Exclude overhead reaching from the initial shoulder-constrained suggestion profile pending individual range review.
rows.movementOutline: Reach up comfortably, then lower your arms.
instructions: Reach up comfortably, then lower your arms.

rows.name: Supine abdominal bracing
rows.purposeReview: Gentle abdominal activation and breathing control.
rows.individualReview: Review comfortable supine support and bent knees. Source context is pelvic health; do not transfer its treatment dose.
rows.movementOutline: Lie comfortably with knees bent. Gently draw in the lower tummy as you breathe out, then relax. Keep breathing.
instructions: Rest on your back with bent knees; keep your spine and pelvis comfortable and supported.
During an easy out-breath, gently engage the lower abdominal area without moving your pelvis; relax fully.
Continue breathing. Do not strain or chase the countdown.

rows.name: Supine pelvic tilts
rows.individualReview: Review back/hip comfort and shoulder/head support; do not count timer minutes as strengthening.
rows.movementOutline: With knees bent and feet resting, slowly tilt the pelvis to ease the lower back toward the floor, then release. Breathe normally.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet about hip-width apart.
Slowly rock the pelvis between a relaxed position and a gentle lower-back flattening.
Return with control; use a comfortable range rather than forcing the back.

rows.name: Supine heel slides
rows.purposeReview: Low-load trunk control with supported leg movement; activation.
rows.individualReview: Review knee/hip travel, abdominal control and shoulder/head support. No long-lever progression by default.
rows.movementOutline: Gently engage the tummy. Slide one heel away and back while keeping the back steady; alternate sides without holding your breath.
instructions: Start on your back with knees bent and heels resting.
With gentle abdominal tension, slide one heel away and return it, keeping the trunk steady.
Alternate legs at your own pace. Stop the slide before losing comfortable control.

rows.name: Modified dead bug
rows.individualReview: Keep the physiotherapist-guided variation/art lock. Arms-down is not an automatically approved shoulder modification.
rows.movementOutline: Locked: ask a physiotherapist to select the leg/arm variation before using this candidate.
instructions: The NHS level-3 progression starts with bent legs raised, then controlled leg lowering; its full dead bug adds opposite arm movement.
The leaflet separately describes a leg-only extension before the overhead-arm progression. Exact arm support and lever length need individual selection.
This app does not prescribe an unreviewed shoulder modification.

rows.name: Glute bridge
rows.purposeReview: Hip/glute strengthening with trunk stabilisation; not isolated abdominal strengthening.
rows.individualReview: Bent-knee loading and upper-back/shoulder contact both matter. Keep existing conservative caps; no single-leg variation.
rows.movementOutline: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Gently lift the hips with control, then lower slowly; do not force the height.
instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees and feet resting roughly hip-width apart.
Gently engage the abdomen and buttocks, lift the pelvis in a controlled movement, then lower gradually.
Use only your individually reviewed range; do not push for repetitions or height to fill the timer.

rows.name: Bent-knee fall-out
rows.purposeReview: Trunk/pelvic control while one bent knee moves sideways. Do not assume substantial strengthening without reviewing effort and dose.
rows.movementOutline: Supine with feet resting; move one bent knee a small controlled distance outward and return while the pelvis and other knee stay still. Arms remain resting.
rows.individualReview: Hip rotation, bent-knee tolerance, back control and floor/shoulder support require individual review. No treatment dose or range is prescribed here.
rows.sourceSection: Printed exercise page: bent knee fall out (PDF page 4).
rows.sourceContext: Continuation leaflet for people who completed physiotherapy Pilates. It is not clearance for a new programme.
rows.pacing: Unspecified pending individual review; no rep target or scheduling window.

rows.name: Single knee fold (one leg at a time)
rows.purposeReview: Abdominal/pelvic control with an unsupported leg; potentially more demanding than heel slides. Classification and dose remain unresolved.
rows.movementOutline: Source scissors level 1: lift one bent leg from a supported supine start, lower it fully, then alternate. Keep arms resting; do not use the two-legs-raised progression.
rows.individualReview: Review trunk control, hip/knee position, back symptoms and supported head/shoulder contact. No automatic progression from a tolerated heel slide.
rows.sourceSection: Scissors level 1, printed page 10 of 31; not level 2.
rows.sourceContext: NHS physiotherapy exercise booklet with multiple levels; printed review date June 2026 has passed. Wirral leaflet also describes single-leg-at-a-time scissors. No personal suitability or dose is inferred.
rows.pacing: Unspecified pending individual review; no rep target or scheduling window.
